Calamari Rings

About This Entry

Calamari rings are prepared cross-cut squid — breaded and fried worldwide. Prosecco, Pinot Grigio, and pale lager-friendly whites cut fried richness.

What is Calamari Rings?

How should Calamari Rings be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
